Home/Privacy

Your files. Your workspace.

Privacy information · Updated 2026-09-22

File processing

File processing happens in your browser. The application does not upload selected files to a server. Files remain in page memory while you work; refreshing or leaving the page clears the working session. Export anything you want to keep.

Libraries and model downloads

Most processing libraries are served with this website and loaded only when needed. OCR downloads English language data from jsDelivr. Background removal downloads its model and runtime assets from IMG.LY. These providers receive network information such as your IP address and browser headers. File content is not included in those requests. Your browser may cache downloaded assets.

Website hosting

The website host receives normal HTTP requests and may retain access and security logs. This mobile review version is hosted on GitHub Pages. Production hosting and a public contact method must be identified before a public commercial launch.

Accounts, analytics and advertising

AllToolForest tools require no account. No advertising or analytics scripts are included. A private review deployment may separately require host authentication. Adding analytics, advertising, server processing or cookies will require an updated policy and any applicable consent controls before activation.

Requests and external links

Tool requests are prepared locally. Choosing a GitHub submission opens GitHub; its account requirements, terms and privacy policy apply. Do not include personal or confidential information in public requests.

Calculations and document limitations

Financial and health calculations are informational estimates, not professional advice. The privacy inspector is a limited pattern check, not a forensic review. Visual PDF replacement covers visible content; the original text may still be recoverable.

Contact

A public contact address has not yet been configured for this review version.
